title: astilbe podophylla
intro: Astilbe podophylla, commonly known as American mandrake or May apple, is a perennial plant species native to eastern North America. This plant is used in herbal medicine and has various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Astilbe podophylla are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve stomach issues, and ease menstrual cramps. Its bioactive constituents include podophyllotoxin, lignans, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
